translation_direction: zh → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete Chinese electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Narration uses hắn for Kong Yiji; customers and the proprietor address him as anh; Kong and the boy use tôi/cậu and the boy answers with a dismissive anh.
decisions.rationale: Vietnamese pronouns must encode the tavern’s condescension and Kong’s attempted dignity without adding explanation.

decisions.decision: Convert 『』 to “ ”, ‘ ’ for inner quotation, …… to … and full-width punctuation to Vietnamese conventions.
decisions.rationale: Typographic conversion only; sentence boundaries and dashes follow the source.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: 竊書 rendered only as thiết thư would be opaque to most Vietnamese readers; Kong now glosses it himself (Thiết thư… lấy sách không thể tính là ăn cắp…), keeping both pedantry and legibility.
後來打折了腿了 repeats 打折了腿 as a brutal circular answer; restored as “Sau nữa thì bị đánh gãy chân rồi.”
不成樣子 is ‘wretched’, not ‘no longer human’: now tiều tụy chẳng ra hình dạng gì nữa; 靠着火 now ở bên lò lửa without inventing sitting.
葷菜 covers meat or fish: món mặn.
排出 now xếp ra (lining coins up); 滿口 now mở miệng là.
Smoothed 不屑置辯 (khinh khỉnh, không thèm biện bạch), the grey face (màu tro xám) and restored 之類 (các thứ).
也配 restored as scornful đòi; the boy’s 茴 answer shortened; the fingernail tapping rephrased.
Removed an added emphatic đấy and strengthened 這麽過 (cứ thế mà sống).
Restored 也 in 我纔也覺得 (tôi cũng mới thấy).
主顧也沒有好聲氣 now khách cũng chẳng ai nói năng tử tế.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.rationale: Standard Sino-Vietnamese reading; the nickname’s origin in the copybook phrase 上大人孔乙己 is rendered Thượng đại nhân Khổng Ất Kỷ.
Class markers kept as a fixed pair throughout; áo dài here is the scholar’s long gown, contrasted with labourers’ short jackets.

glossary.source_term: 之乎者也 / 君子固窮 / 多乎哉？不多也
glossary.draft_rendering: chi hồ giả dã / quân tử cố cùng / Đa hồ tai? Bất đa dã.
glossary.rationale: Hán-Việt readings preserve the classical pedantry that the tavern finds half-intelligible; the vernacular “Không nhiều, không nhiều!” before the tag carries its sense.
The joke is a literary verb used to dignify theft; Kong’s own gloss (lấy sách) makes the euphemism legible.

glossary.source_term: 店內外充滿了快活的空氣
glossary.draft_rendering: trong quán ngoài quán tràn ngập bầu không khí vui vẻ
glossary.rationale: An identical ironic refrain at both occurrences.

witness_decision: Selected the validated (proofread level 4) Chinese Wikisource transcription of 魯迅全集 vol. 1 (Lu Xun Memorial Committee edition, 1938; 1948 printing), scan pages 313–318, in traditional characters as printed. The story was first published in 新青年 6.4 (April 1919) and collected in 吶喊 (1923); those earlier texts were not collated.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Đa hồ tai? Bất đa dã. depends on readers’ familiarity with Hán-Việt; the preceding vernacular line carries the meaning but the comic register shifts slightly.
Có lẽ… đích thực keeps the 大約…的確 contradiction, though Vietnamese makes it slightly more explicit than the Chinese.

title_review.rationale: 孔乙己 is the character’s nickname; Khổng Ất Kỷ is the standard Sino-Vietnamese reading, matches every body occurrence and is explained in passage 1.4 by the copybook phrase it comes from.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared the tavern layout, prices, short-jacket and long-gown customers, the boy’s hiring and demotion.
Compared Kong Yiji’s portrait, nickname, theft argument, classical tags, the 茴 exchange, the children and the beans.
Compared the slate, the beating, the final visit, the hands, the repeated debt line, the closing paradox and the dateline.
